exposure: 0.1% ropivacaine with fentanyl continuous epidural infusion
0.125% bupivacaine with fentanyl continuous epidural infusion
cohort: The study included 70 parturients aged 18-35 years in active labour.
finding: Both ropivacaine and bupivacaine with fentanyl offered effective labour analgesia, with ropivacaine demonstrating slightly better maternal outcomes including less motor block and more spontaneous deliveries, though these were not statistically significant.
mod_finding: The ropivacaine group experienced more spontaneous deliveries compared to the bupivacaine group.
